question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class WebChat shortcut/prompt-snippet browser, and which surface should own shortcut definitions and storage?
rationale: The UX need is clear, but implementation requires choosing a durable owner for shortcut metadata before adding config, browser storage, command metadata, or plugin API surface.

options.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
options.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, plugin, or UI-storage metadata contract before building the panel so shortcut discovery has one source of truth.

options.title: Keep shortcuts browser-local
options.body: Implement a Control UI-local shortcut list with browser-profile storage or import/export, avoiding Gateway config while limiting cross-device sharing.

options.title: Defer to plugin contribution APIs
options.body: Hold this until Control UI plugin-panel/contribution direction is settled, then make shortcuts a plugin or bundle surface if that boundary wins.

recommendation.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
recommendation.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, plugin, or UI-storage metadata contract before building the panel so shortcut discovery has one source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the closest merged Control UI slash-command discovery work that this feature must align with or intentionally bypass.
